construction.hamiltonianDecomposition: H=sum_a h_a with each Hermitian term tagged by a support centre r_a
construction.periodicRule: Do not use wrapped Cartesian coordinates naively; validate an oriented seam/twist or minimum-image current against an open-cluster continuity oracle.

codeAudit.presentCurrent: charge current from flux derivatives of tagged hopping terms
codeAudit.missingCurrent: no source-native physical energy-current builder from the full tagged Hamiltonian decomposition
codeAudit.implementationConsequence: The energy current must include commutators among every noncommuting tagged channel; copying a nearest-neighbour t-J formula would omit t-prime, J-prime, V and boundary contributions.

proxyFirewall.energyZeroShift: H->H+cI gives J_E_proxy->J_E_proxy+cJ_N while i[H,P_E] is unchanged
proxyFirewall.allowedUse: matrix-estimator, covariance, positivity and binning plumbing only
proxyFirewall.forbiddenUse: physical thermoelectric rank, heat transport or new-physics inference

implementationPlan: Refactor the Hamiltonian builder so every sparse contribution carries coefficient, support, centre, displacement, boundary winding and interaction-family tags.
Build small-cluster h_a matrices and generate j_ab=i[h_a,h_b] only for overlapping or otherwise noncommuting terms.
Verify Hermiticity, antisymmetry, local continuity and equality with i[H,P_E] on open clusters.
Introduce a periodic seam/twist convention and test seam translation and local-energy repartition as gauge-sensitivity suites.
Apply J_N and J_E to the same random vectors, retain complex cross spectra and use identical Lanczos samples and bins.
Report C_NN, C_NE, C_EE, eigenvalues, determinant and rho with bootstrap covariance over random vectors and flux samples.
Repeat over temperature, filling, size, broadening and energy-density gauges before interpreting low rank.
promotionGates: physical-current implementation passes the open-cluster continuity oracle
periodic results are stable under seam translation within finite-size uncertainty
response matrices are Hermitian positive semidefinite within sampled covariance
rank conclusions survive energy-density repartition, bin-width and random-vector resampling
the proxy and physical-current outputs are reported side by side and are statistically distinguishable

failureInterpretation.rankOnePhysical: A single dissipative transport combination dominates in the tested window; this is useful strange-metal structure but not Spin(2,3) evidence.
failureInterpretation.rankTwoPhysical: A genuine interior two-current response is present; test congruence, scaling and cross-channel predictions next.
failureInterpretation.indefiniteMatrix: Estimator, complex cross-spectrum convention or sampling has failed; no physical interpretation is allowed.
failureInterpretation.gaugeSensitive: Finite-size/boundary definition is unresolved; enlarge clusters or reformulate the periodic current.
failureInterpretation.noPlanckianWindow: The original scalar phenomenology does not extend to the full thermoelectric sector; retain the negative bound.
